abstract.text: A decoded JSON Web Signature (JWS) header.
The algorithm the App Store uses for signing the JSON Web Signature (JWS).
An array that contains the X.509 certificate chain, which you use to verify the public key that the App Store uses to sign the JWS.

paragraphs.text: The type `RealtimeRequestBody` contains a header that’s a `JWSDecodedHeader` object when decoded. Use the information in the `JWSDecodedHeader` to validate the JWS signature of the request body. For more information about validating signatures, see the JSON Web Signature (JWS) `https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515` specification.
